SELECT m.formula, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c1
    WHERE c1.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c1.atomic_fraction = 0.75
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c2
    WHERE c2.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c2.atomic_fraction = 0.25
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Co'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.strukturbericht, s.prototype, s.space_group_number, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'Ti'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Pt'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_ni
    WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_al
    WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'Ga'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element, c.site_label
FROM composition c
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.crystal_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂') OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂'))
  AND s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'W'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.chemical_system ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 3.5
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Nb'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Sc'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pd'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 1
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ir'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
ORDER BY
  c_a.element,
  c_b.element,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) <= 0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction = 0.75
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    c.element,
    c.site_label,
    c.atomic_fraction,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
    AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  END AS stability

SELECT

  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

WHERE
  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
    SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m_ref
    JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id

    JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,

SELECT

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT
  m.formula,

  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.lattice_a,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c_a.element AS a_site, c_b.element AS b_site
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.prototype,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1.0 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
   + (1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
   + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_ni
      WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_co
      WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_co.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  COUNT(*) AS l12_combination_count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, l12_combination_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1.0 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.30) AS total_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance AS e_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry ON phase_diagram_entry.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH compound AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.reference_set
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
    LIMIT 1
),
ref_energies AS (
    SELECT c.entry_id,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.delta_e) AS weighted_ref
    FROM compound c
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = c.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
        AND per.reference_set = c.reference_set
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT c.formula,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom,
       r.weighted_ref AS ref_energy,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom - r.weighted_ref AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM compound c
JOIN ref_energies r ON r.entry_id = c.entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1.0 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1.0 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY design_score DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
         WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                            'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
       END AS a_site_transition_metal_group,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
GROUP BY CASE
           WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
           WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                              'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
         END
ORDER BY a_site_transition_metal_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    AND NOT (
        m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
        SELECT
            ps.formation_energy_per_atom
        FROM material_entry m
        JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
        JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
        WHERE
            (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
            AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND cp.value > (
        SELECT
            cp.value
        FROM material_entry m
        JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
        JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
        JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        WHERE
            (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
            AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
            AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        ORDER BY cp.value DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
    + 0.0 * 0.20
    + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_renormalized_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_renormalized_formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
       m.formula,
       c_a.element AS a_element,
       c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_atomic_fraction,
       c_b.element AS b_element,
       c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND c_a.atomic_fraction = 0.75
  AND c_b.atomic_fraction = 0.25
  AND c_a.element <> c_b.element
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 1
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable

    ((1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
     + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
     + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300) * 0.30) AS total_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS e_hull,
  s.lattice_a,

   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

SELECT

  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY design_score DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC

SELECT CASE
         WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metals'
         WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                            'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metals'
       END AS a_site_transition_metal_group,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform

  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
    SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m_ref
    JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    WHERE (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
    SELECT cp_ref.value
    FROM material_entry m_ref
    JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id

      AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND NOT (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND (
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_co WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_co.element = 'Co')

SELECT m.formula,
       pde.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ((1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
        + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
        + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT

    s.lattice_a,

FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT

  ps.is_stable,

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE

SELECT

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

SELECT site_group,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.entry_id,
           CASE
               WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
               WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                                  'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
           END AS site_group,
           ps.energy_above_hull,
           ps.is_stable,
           ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
      AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                        'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                        'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
) grouped_l12
GROUP BY site_group
ORDER BY site_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND NOT (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
          AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      WHERE (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC) AS rank,
  formula,
  energy_above_hull,
  lattice_a,
  lattice_diff,
  formation_energy_per_atom,
  composite_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    (
      (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
      + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
      + 0.0 * 0.20
      + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
    ) AS composite_score
  FROM material_entry m
  JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
  JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
  WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT m.formula,

SELECT

    phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (1 - phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
      + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
      + (cp.value / 300) * 0.3 AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry ON phase_diagram_entry.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'

  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (
    WHERE ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  ) AS metastable_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05) AS unstable_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_percentage,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1.0 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.30) AS overall_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT

    pde.hull_distance AS e_hull,
    s.lattice_a,

SELECT

  ps.energy_above_hull,

    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC

SELECT

  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT

  CASE

    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',

WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    WHERE (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

    AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND NOT (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (SELECT formation_energy_per_atom FROM ni3al_ref)
  AND cp_bm.value > (SELECT bulk_modulus FROM ni3al_ref)

    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
